summary:
麥當勞最新季度財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現穩健的營運韌性。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 3.38 美元，優於市場預期的 3.32 美元。
• 總營收達 71 億美元，較去年同期成長 3.76%。
• 本益比保持在 20.56 倍，估值水準相對合理。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健展現防禦屬性，訊號中性偏多。短中期利於支撐股價表現，後續應追蹤全球同店銷售額成長率及利潤率變化。

需留意：全球消費者面臨通膨壓力，可能壓抑餐飲消費支出。；餐飲與勞動成本上升可能持續侵蝕利潤率。

summary_en:
McDonald's reported quarterly EPS and revenue that both beat market expectations, demonstrating solid operational resilience.
• EPS of $3.38 outperformed the estimated $3.32.
• Total revenue reached $7.10B, representing a 3.76% year-over-year increase.
• Trailing P/E ratio stands at a relatively reasonable 20.56.

ai_view_en:
View: Solid financial results reflect strong defensive attributes, signaling a neutral-to-positive outlook. This supports near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key metrics to track include global comparable store sales growth and margin trends.

Watch：Global consumers facing inflationary pressures may reduce discretionary dining outlays.; Rising food and labor costs could continue to pressure profit margins.
